correctness.rationale: For a fresh point, exactly the triangle-free neighbor sets are admissible in the Henson K4-free limit. Homogeneity makes each adjacency pattern one complete type; adding independent fresh points with that pattern gives arbitrarily many realizations. Chordality identifies the polynomial with the induced-forest polynomial. I filtered all labeled (2n-3)-edge graphs by simplicial degree-two peeling to an edge, quotiented by all permutations, and computed polynomials by triangle-union inclusion–exclusion. This independently reproduces 1,1,1,2,5 classes and the unique order-six collision with the given triangle lists and polynomial. At the specified edge the two restricted polynomials are z^2(1+z)^2. A fan vertex is allowed iff the old subset omits at least one edge endpoint, giving the all-t formula; the degree-three vertices of B_t distinguish it from A_t. The coefficient of z distinguishes different orders.
residual_risks: The complete census ends at six vertices. The infinite family is not a classification of later collisions. Equality of graded counts does not identify labeled types.
